channel.description: Recent content in Posts on Anders E. Vrålstad Portfolio

item.title: Research paper "Coherence-Based Sound Speed Aberration Correction" published in IEEE TMI
item.description:
My third paper for my PhD called “Coherence-Based Sound Speed Aberration Correction — With Clinical Validation in Fetal Ultrasound” is now peer reviewed and published in IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging. Access the paper and supplemmentary material here.

Read more about it on the project page.

item.title: Research paper "Retrospective Transmit Correction of Blocked Arrays Applied to Cardiac Ultrasound Imaging" is published
item.description:
A new paper I worked on after my PhD is now publised in IEEE Transactions on Ultrasonics. The title of the paper is “Retrospective Transmit Correction of Blocked Arrays Applied to Cardiac Ultrasound Imaging”. Read the paper here.

The code for creating the simulations are found at the USTB website by following this link.

item.title: Presentation at the 2025 IEEE International Ultrasonics Symposium
item.description:
I presented my recent work on sound speed aberration correction. The talk was titled “Coherence Based Sound Speed Aberration Correction — with Clinical Validation in Fetal Ultrasound”.

Read more about it on the project page.

item.title: PhD thesis: Retrospective beamforming and sound speed correction
item.description:
My PhD thesis “Retrospective beamforming and sound speed correction” is published in Norwegian Research Information Repository.

Read the thesis here.

item.title: Preprint of "Coherence Based Sound Speed Aberration Correction"
item.description:
My third paper for my PhD is called “Coherence Based Sound Speed Aberration Correction — with clinical validation in obstetric ultrasound”. A preprint of the paper is found on arXiv.

Read more about it on the project page.

item.title: Sound Speed and Virtual Source Correction in Synthetic Transmit Focusing
item.description:
My first paper for my PhD is called “Sound Speed and Virtual Source Correction in Synthetic Transmit Focusing” and is published in IEEE Open Journal of Ultrasonics, Ferroelectrics, and Frequency Control (Volume 4).

Read the open-access article here.

item.title: Universal REFoCUS Beamforming With Spatial Weighting
item.description:
My second paper for my PhD is called “Universal REFoCUS Beamforming With Spatial Weighting” and is published in IEEE Open Journal of Ultrasonics, Ferroelectrics, and Frequency Control (Volume 4).

Read the open-access article here.

item.title: Lecture presentation at the 2023 IEEE International Ultrasonics Symposium
item.description:
I presented a poster of my recent work on “Universal Refocus Beamforming with Pixel Dependent Apodization”. This work will be part of an upcomming research paper.

Watch the video where I explain the work here.

item.title: Presentation at the NFUD Symposium 2023
item.description: I presented my work on distributed sound speed aberratoin correction on the symposium organized by Norsk forening for ultralyddiagnostikk (NFUD) in Tromsø. The title of the talk was “Lydhastighetskorrigering i fosteravbildning”.

item.title: Poster presentation at the 2022 IEEE International Ultrasonics Symposium
item.description:
I presented a poster of my recent work on “Sound speed and virtual source correction for retrospective transmit beamforming”. This work will be part of an upcomming research paper.

Watch the video where I explain the work here.
